title: Sefer ha-Zohar (Hebrew, Lublin 1882 print)
author: Moses de Leon
description: A historical Hebrew edition of the Zohar, a foundational collection of Jewish mystical interpretation. Its readings of Torah explore divine life, symbolic correspondences and the relationship between the visible world and its spiritual dimensions.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/seferhazohar31unse).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
